nodes.content: Design an incremental compiler that soundly reuses cross-module typechecking results despite edits changing overload and trait resolution.
requirements: Match clean-build diagnostics and executable behavior across edits, including newly applicable candidates and ambiguities.
Reuse at least 95% of typechecking results for declarations whose resolution dependencies remain semantically unchanged.

nodes.content: Cache declaration typechecks against indexed positive and negative resolution queries; revalidate affected queries and invalidate only changed semantic outcomes.
How should negative resolution queries represent visibility and applicability so new overloads or trait implementations invalidate affected declarations?
Scope-qualified candidate-set queries keyed by overload name or canonical trait goal will catch newly applicable candidates after index changes.
Index scoped name and unification-compatible trait-goal queries, including empty sets; recheck resolutions after visibility or implementation edits.
Run ResolutionFlip-1000 overload and blanket-impl edits; compare cached diagnostics and behavior against clean builds and measure unchanged-declaration reuse.
ResolutionFlip-1000 matched clean-build diagnostics and executable behavior across 1,000 edits, including ambiguities; unchanged-dependency reuse was 97.2%.
Adopt scoped positive and negative candidate-set dependencies, supported by ResolutionFlip-1000 parity and 97.2% unchanged-dependency reuse.
Implement chosen candidate-set dependencies with signature/visibility fingerprints and selective rechecks; require clean-build diagnostic/execution parity and ≥95% reuse.
Implement TypeCache v2 with reverse-indexed scoped candidate queries, empty-set records, and selective rechecks after signature, visibility, or impl edits.
TypeCache v2 records scoped positive and negative candidate queries and selectively rechecks declarations when indexed resolution outcomes change.
Test TypeCache v2 on WorkspaceEdit-500 visibility/overload/impl edits; compare diagnostics and behavior to clean builds, recording unchanged-dependency reuse.
WorkspaceEdit-500 matched clean-build diagnostics on 500/500 edits and behavior on 312/312 runnable cases; unchanged-dependency reuse averaged 96.8%.
How should cached trait proofs track transitive where-clause obligations when candidate heads remain unchanged across modules?
Run TransitiveWhere-200 edits changing imported where-clause proofs without changing impl heads; compare TypeCache v2 diagnostics and behavior against clean builds.
TransitiveWhere-200 found 17/200 stale diagnostics and 6 behavioral mismatches: unchanged candidate sets concealed altered imported where-clause proofs.
Extend TypeCache v2 with transitive trait-obligation dependencies, including failed proofs; recheck cached declarations when proof outcomes change.
How can transitive proof dependencies capture failed and cyclic obligations without invalidating declarations for irrelevant impl edits?
Canonical obligation proof DAGs with SCC and failed-goal dependencies should eliminate TransitiveWhere-200 mismatches while preserving ≥95% unchanged-dependency reuse.
Add canonical proof DAG/SCC and failed-goal indexes to TypeCache v2; test TransitiveWhere-200 parity and unchanged-dependency reuse.
TransitiveWhere-200 had zero diagnostic or behavioral mismatches, but SCC-wide invalidation reduced unchanged-dependency reuse to 91.6%, below 95%.
Keep transitive proof tracking to fix stale results, but replace SCC-wide invalidation: 91.6% reuse misses the 95% target.
Per-goal fixed-point proof fingerprints within SCCs, including failed goals, should preserve parity and raise unchanged-dependency reuse above 95%.
Implement per-goal fixed-point fingerprints; rerun TransitiveWhere-200 and WorkspaceEdit-500, comparing clean-build parity and unchanged-dependency reuse.
Both suites matched clean-build diagnostics across 700 edits and behavior in 438 runnable cases; reuse rose from 91.6% to 96.3%.
Implement TypeCache v3 with per-goal proof fingerprints and candidate-set indexes; gate release on clean-build parity and ≥95% reuse.
Integrate TypeCache v3 candidate queries and per-goal proof fingerprints into cross-module invalidation; add clean-build parity and reuse gates.
TypeCache v3 stores scoped candidate queries and per-goal fixed-point proof fingerprints, selectively invalidating cross-module declaration typechecks.
Store per-declaration constraint snapshots; replay overload and trait solving against edited interfaces, retaining typechecks only when semantic outcomes match.
Index constraint snapshots by scope, name, and trait goal; replay affected constraints against edited interfaces before reusing unchanged typechecks.
Extend TypeCache v2 with indexed constraint snapshots; replay affected overload and trait goals across WorkspaceEdit-500 edits.
ReplayCache prototype stores indexed declaration constraint snapshots and re-solves affected overload and trait goals before retaining cached typechecks.
Benchmark ReplayCache against TypeCache v3 on WorkspaceEdit-500 and TransitiveWhere-200 for clean-build parity, reuse, and replay cost.
ReplayCache matched clean-build diagnostics (700/700) and behavior (438/438); reuse reached 95.8%, at 1.2× TypeCache v3 latency.
Choose TypeCache v3: both match clean builds, but its 96.3% reuse exceeds ReplayCache’s 95.8% at lower latency.
CacheBench report records 700-edit parity, 438 behavioral matches, and TypeCache v3’s 96.3% reuse versus ReplayCache’s 95.8%.
Using CacheBench baselines, fuzz 2,000 cross-module coherence and cyclic-trait edits; compare TypeCache v3 and ReplayCache parity, reuse, latency.
CoherenceFuzz-2000 found nine TypeCache v3 stale ambiguities after coherence edits; ReplayCache matched diagnostics (2,000/2,000), behavior (1,214/1,214), with 95.4% reuse.
How should ReplayCache detect upstream type-alias or associated-type edits that change a constraint’s indexed trait goal?
Using CacheBench baselines, test AliasShift-300 cross-module alias and associated-type edits for missed ReplayCache goal reindexing, parity, and reuse.
AliasShift-300 exposed 11 stale diagnostics and 4 behavioral mismatches: alias edits changed canonical goals without triggering snapshot replay.
Prefer ReplayCache’s ≥95% reuse and coherence parity over TypeCache v3, contingent on alias-normalization invalidation fixing AliasShift-300.
Record alias and associated-type normalization dependencies per snapshot; on edits, renormalize and reindex affected goals before replay.
Patch ReplayCache to track normalization dependencies and reindex goals after alias edits; rerun AliasShift-300 against clean builds.
ReplayCache v2 extends the prototype with normalization-dependency indexes, renormalizing and reindexing affected trait goals before constraint replay.
Maintain differential resolver fixed points for aliases, candidates, proofs, and coherence; invalidate declarations when their resolution outcomes change.
How can differential fixed points handle cyclic trait proofs and coherence ambiguities without invalidating declarations whose outcomes remain unchanged?
Per-goal SCC fixed points with coherence-set fingerprints should preserve clean-build parity while reusing ≥95% of unchanged-dependency typechecks.
Prototype differential SCC and coherence fingerprints atop ReplayCache v2; test CoherenceFuzz-2000 and AliasShift-300 for parity and reuse.
CoherenceFuzz-2000 and AliasShift-300 matched clean-build diagnostics (2,300/2,300) and runnable behavior (1,350/1,350); unchanged-dependency reuse reached 95.6%.
Ship differential resolution atop ReplayCache v2, tracking alias, candidate, proof, and coherence fixed points; gate on parity and ≥95% reuse.
Integrate differential SCC and coherence fingerprints into ReplayCache v2; add clean-build parity and ≥95% reuse release checks.
DiffResolve v1 adds differential alias, candidate, proof, and coherence updates to ReplayCache v2, with parity and reuse gates.
Run EditChain-1200 sequential alias, import, overload, and impl edits through DiffResolve v1; compare clean-build diagnostics, behavior, and reuse.
EditChain-1200 matched clean-build diagnostics (1,200/1,200) and runnable behavior (710/710); unchanged-dependency reuse averaged 95.9%.
Validate per-declaration resolution certificates against edited interface summaries, including candidate absence, alias normalization, and coherence witnesses.
How can resolution certificates prove candidate absence across wildcard reexports without rescanning every imported module after an edit?
Name-partitioned transitive export summaries with scope-filtered fingerprints should validate wildcard candidate absence without rescanning unrelated modules.
Implement name-partitioned export summaries atop DiffResolve v1; test WildcardExport-400 for clean-build parity and unrelated-module rescans.
WildcardExport-400 found 8 stale ambiguities: cyclic wildcard reexports changed visibility paths that name-partitioned summaries failed to track.
SCC-aware, name-partitioned export fixed points with visibility-path witnesses should validate cyclic wildcard absence without rescanning unrelated modules.
Add SCC-aware export fixed points and visibility-path certificates to DiffResolve v1; rerun WildcardExport-400 for clean-build parity, rescans, and reuse.
WildcardExport-400 matched diagnostics (400/400) and behavior (248/248); unrelated-module rescans fell to zero, with 95.5% unchanged-dependency reuse.
Adopt SCC-aware visibility certificates atop ReplayCache-based DiffResolve: fixes cyclic-reexport ambiguities while preserving clean-build parity and 95.5% reuse.
Integrate SCC-aware export certificates into DiffResolve and release-gate cross-module edits on clean-build parity and ≥95% unchanged-dependency reuse.
Merge validated SCC-aware export certificates into DiffResolve v1 and add WildcardExport-400 to parity and reuse CI gates.
DiffResolve v2 includes SCC-aware export certificates, differential resolution updates, and CI gates for clean-build parity and ≥95% reuse.
Run MixedScope-1000 interleaved reexport, alias, overload, and impl edits against DiffResolve v2; compare clean-build parity and reuse.
MixedScope-1000 matched clean-build diagnostics (1,000/1,000) and runnable behavior (603/603); unchanged-dependency reuse averaged 95.7%.
Release DiffResolve v2 with SCC-aware visibility certificates: MixedScope-1000 met clean-build parity and 95.7% unchanged-dependency reuse.
